# Biteperk

> Biteperk builds Voco — one AI phone host for Australian restaurants, voiced by "Bella", a warm Australian voice that answers every call, day or night. Voco does four jobs from a single agent: bookings and takeaway & pickup ordering (live today), a front-of-house concierge (in development), and a drive-thru order-taker (concept). Venues start with bookings and switch on the rest as they ship — same agent, same voice, same number. Built, hosted and supported in Sydney; serving restaurants, cafés and venues Australia-wide. (Voco's live capabilities ship under the product names "VocoTable" for bookings and "VocoOrder" for takeaway.)

## Key facts

- Company: Biteperk Pty Ltd, a Sydney-based voice/AI software company for hospitality.
- Location: Level 1, 477 Pitt Street, Haymarket NSW 2000, Australia (serves all of Australia).
- Contact: phone 0450 011 140 (+61 450 011 140); email hello@biteperk.com.au; hours Mon–Fri 9am–5pm AEST.
- Product: Voco — one AI phone host (the voice is "Bella"). Its capabilities are bookings and takeaway/pickup (live), concierge (in development), and drive-thru (concept). Bookings ship as "VocoTable" (serving paying customers); takeaway/pickup ships as "VocoOrder".
- VocoTable pricing (AUD, flat monthly, no per-call or per-cover fees): Solo $80/month (up to 300 covers, 1 venue), Pro $150/month (unlimited covers — "Our pick"), Group $250/month (up to 3 venues), Enterprise custom (4+ venues). Free week trial; month-to-month, no lock-in.
- Setup: works with a venue's existing phone number — just forward calls. No new hardware, no installation, no IT. Most venues are live the same day.
- The AI voice ("Bella") speaks natural Australian English and gets local suburb/street names right — not an overseas call centre.
- Data/privacy: Australian data residency (audio processed in Australia); Privacy Act compliant; call audio is kept only as long as needed to confirm the booking, then deleted; never used to train AI models outside Biteperk; your bookings and data stay yours and are exported within 24 hours if you cancel. (See the privacy policy for specifics.)

## Voco — one product, four capabilities

Voco is a single AI phone host. Each capability below is a job the same agent does — not a separate product. Restaurants start with bookings and add the rest as they ship; same agent, same voice, same number.

- [Bookings — VocoTable](https://biteperk.com.au/products/vocotable/): **Live.** The core capability every venue starts with. "Bella" answers every call on the first ring, 24/7, handles the booking conversation, and writes reservations straight into the venue's diary against real availability (no double-bookings). Pricing: Solo $80 / Pro $150 / Group $250 per month / Enterprise custom — flat, no per-call or per-cover fees, free week trial.
- [Takeaway & pickup — VocoOrder](https://biteperk.com.au/products/vocoorder/): **Live.** AI phone ordering for takeaway and pickup — the same agent handles the order, the modifiers, and the pickup time, then sends a clean ticket to the POS. Book a demo.
- [Concierge — VocoConcierge](https://biteperk.com.au/products/vococoncierge/): **In development.** Voice + SMS front-of-house concierge — nudges the waitlist, confirms upcoming covers, recovers no-shows, and replies when guests text back. Waitlist open.
- [Drive-thru — VocoDrive](https://biteperk.com.au/products/vocodrive/): **Concept.** A voice agent for the drive-through window, built for the Australian morning rush — local accents and ordering rhythms, not a US franchise script. Register interest.
- [All capabilities — the Voco overview](https://biteperk.com.au/products/): What's live, what's in development, and how the add-ons fit together as one front-of-house line.
